players.product: Vertically integrated SiC substrates, epitaxy and power chips (Hunan Sanan 6-inch and 8-inch SiC lines, GaN-on-Si); 8-inch SiC substrates from Chongqing Sanan for the Anyifa 8-inch SiC epitaxy and chip joint venture

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Lin Zhiqiang (2025 annual results briefing): the company's 12-inch SiC substrates have been sampled to customers for validation, with initial capacity of 500 wafers a month. CFO Huang Zhijun said the Quanzhou Sanan project has planned total investment of RMB 333 hundred million (including public supporting facilities); it mainly makes vertical-structure and flip-chip products and its capacity is being released, and he expects its sales and profit to rise as demand grows and customer shipments speed up.
quarterly_data.figure: 12-inch SiC substrate initial capacity 500 wafers/month; Quanzhou project planned investment RMB 333 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical and Micro LED (2025 annual results briefing): chairman Lin Zhiqiang said optical-chip capacity is 2,750 wafers a month with the core epitaxy step expanded to 6,000 wafers a month; chips for 400G and 800G optical modules are in volume shipment and chips for 1.6T modules have been sampled to customers; EML sample development and validation are progressing smoothly but the validation cycle is long. In AR glasses the company has deep strategic cooperation with several leading domestic and overseas end customers on Micro LED display, and its Micro LED products for AI data-center optical interconnect have been sampled to leading companies for module-assembly validation.
